mapper.sql: B.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, B.BID_PBANC_NO AS bidPbancNo, B.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, B.PBANC_STTS_CD AS pbancSttsCd, C.CD_NM AS pbancSttsNm, B.LMT_PAGE_CNT AS lmtPageCnt, NVL(B.DMND_INST_NM, B.ORDER_INST_NM) AS instNm, B.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN AS sprvsnTeamSn, ST.TEAM_NM AS sprvsnTeamNm, (SELECT LISTAGG(PT.TEAM_NM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY PT.TEAM_NM) FROM TB_PTCP_TEAM P JOIN TB_TEAM PT ON PT.TEAM_SN = P.TEAM_SN WHERE P.PBANC_SN = B.PBANC_SN) AS ptcpTeamNms, (SELECT MU.TEAM_SN FROM TB_USER MU WHERE MU.USER_ID = #{userId}) AS myTeamSn, (SELECT MIN(MM.PTCP_SE_CD) FROM TB_PRP_TMMBR MM WHERE MM.PBANC_SN = B.PBANC_SN AND MM.USER_ID = #{userId}) AS myPtcpSeCd
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_BID_PBANC B JOIN TB_PRP_TMMBR M ON M.PBANC_SN = B.PBANC_SN AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD C ON C.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND C.CD = B.PBANC_STTS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM ST ON ST.TEAM_SN = B.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN ORDER BY B.PBANC_SN DESC
SELECT FROM TB_BID_PBANC B LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD C ON C.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND C.CD = B.PBANC_STTS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM ST ON ST.TEAM_SN = B.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN WHERE B.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PRP_TMMBR WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT U.USER_ID AS userId, U.USER_NM AS userNm, T.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, M.PTCP_SE_CD AS ptcpSeCd, U.AUTHRT_CD AS authrtCd FROM TB_PRP_TMMBR M JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM T ON T.TEAM_SN = U.TEAM_SN WHERE M.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND M.PTCP_SE_CD IN ('PT010', 'PT020') AND U.ACNT_STTS_CD <> 'AS050' ORDER BY M.PTCP_SE_CD, U.USER_NM
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BID_PBANC SET LMT_PAGE_CNT = #{lmtPageCnt} WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn}
